_about: Facts checked against published sources, read by hand on 2026-11-25. tools/research_ski_descriptions.py prefers these over values derived from our map lines and elevation model. Lengths are inclined (along the cable or slope) unless length_kind says otherwise. Altitudes in metres. Values not listed here stay map estimates and are marked length_source/alt_source 'map' in data_src/ski_descriptions_en.json.
